notes.title: Biwar Legend Of Dragon Slayer Demo Live Stream and Talks with Developers.
notes.content:
[b]These are pre-recorded footages, we are going to broadcast some playthroughs and trailers. If you have any questions. Feel free to ask us anything via Chat or Join us [b][url=https://discord.gg/rdEgyGaau4][b]Discord[/b][/url][/b] server to more discuss![/b]

[h1][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/About_Game.png?t=1657413170[/img][/h1]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/Features.png?t=1657413170[/img]
[list]
[*] Play as Biwar, a teenager from Papua island who adventures in the forbidden forest to discover the truth about a dragon and why his parents died. The game is set in a beautiful ancient Balinese environment and Papuan folklore is unique to Nusantara
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/EPCI_ENVIRONMENT.gif?t=1657413170[/img]

[*] Adventure to explore forgotten Balinese ancient mystical environment and solve puzzles using magic mechanics, such as Telekinesis power, red and blue elements, and Non-Euclidean puzzle
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/animasi_puzzles02.gif?t=1657413170[/img]

[*] Fight Mythology Creatures with a machete (Indonesian sword), shield, and bow of magic elements. Attack them with multi-style action and finally defeat the dragon
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/stylized_combat02.gif?t=1657413170[/img]
[/list]


Join [b][url=https://discord.gg/rdEgyGaau4][b]Discord[/b][/url][/b] server to discuss with the dev and of other players!
